issue_request: FHIR-15713 asked that the Definition.status table row stop describing the lifecycle status as specific to a Value Set or Concept Map and instead use broader an/this artifact wording. The Jira issue is Published, Persuasive, and was applied for STU3.

additional_context: Current source has been refactored since STU3, including CanonicalResource and many derived resources, but active conformance sources continue to use PublicationStatus with the corrected artifact wording. source/fhir.ini lists canonicalresource as an active infrastructure interface and valueset/conceptmap as active resources. Community searches found no substantive Zulip or Confluence evidence changing the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the issue and no source edit is needed.
